scenario: His captain was injured before a crucial match, he was asked to lead the team?
sample_responses: He led the team to victory.
He accepted the responsibility, motivated the team and they won the match.
He studied the opponent's strategy, planned accordingly and led the team to victory.

scenario: He was on his way to home and suddenly it started raining heavily?
sample_responses: He ran fast and reached home.
He took shelter under a tree and waited for the rain to stop.
He called his family to bring an umbrella and then went home.

scenario: You are an officer posted at the border and suddenly shelling happens from the other side, you will
sample_responses: Order troops to stay in shell-proof bunkers, inform the CO and request for counter shelling.
Ensure all soldiers are in protective positions, assess the situation and respond as per orders.
Take cover, communicate with headquarters and prepare for any eventuality.

scenario: You are in an unknown city and lost your purse. You need money. As a stranger how will you manage?
sample_responses: I will ask my parents to send money through PayTm.
I will go to the police station, report the loss and contact my family for help.
I will find a cyber cafe, contact my family and arrange for money transfer.

scenario: Your brother wants to get admission in a medical college but his marks fall short by 1% for admission. You'll
sample_responses: Ask him to try in other colleges where his marks are within cut-off.
Help him explore other medical colleges or consider taking a drop and preparing better.
Support him in finding alternative options like private colleges or related courses.

scenario: You have to go to a city with cash to work but the way is dangerous as dacoits. How will you manage to go?
sample_responses: I will avoid carrying cash and use the credit card.
I will travel with a group, inform the police and take necessary precautions.
I will use digital payment methods or arrange for bank transfer instead of carrying cash.

scenario: He was traveling by train and suddenly a person snatches purse from lady and jumps out of train. He
sample_responses: He pulls chain, jumps down and catches the criminal, recovers purse and hands over criminal to police.
He immediately alerts the TTE, pulls the emergency chain and helps the lady file a report.
He notes the criminal's description, informs the police at next station and assists in identification.

scenario: You are going to sign a contract suddenly you got news that one of your friend who had helped you once met an accident and is in ICU. You'll
sample_responses: Sign the contract and then go to the hospital to meet the friend.
Quickly inform my family to go to the hospital, complete the contract signing and then rush to meet my friend.
Explain the situation to the concerned parties, try to reschedule if possible, otherwise complete the task and go.

scenario: He had boarded a wrong train and came to know only when he was asked to pay money to TT. He
sample_responses: Explained the situation to TT, apologised and took the right train.
Paid the penalty fare, got off at the next station and took the correct train.
Explained his mistake to the TT and sought his help in getting off at the nearest station to catch the right train.

scenario: He saw his girlfriend walking with another person on his way. He
sample_responses: Trusted his friend and did nothing.
Greeted them politely and continued on his way, trusting his relationship.
Later asked his girlfriend about the person in a calm and mature manner.

scenario: He was on his way to the railway station to catch a train; suddenly a car passes by and throws a person out of the running car. He
sample_responses: He will help the person with the appropriate first aid, inform police, and then catch his train.
Immediately calls for ambulance, provides first aid, informs police and then proceeds to catch his train.
Notes the car number, helps the injured person, calls for medical help and then continues his journey.

scenario: He was driving the bike without a helmet and the traffic police caught him. He
sample_responses: He apologised, paid fine and never repeated the mistake.
Accepted his mistake, paid the challan and promised to always wear a helmet.
Understood the importance of the rule, paid the fine and became more responsible.

scenario: He was asked to organise the farewell party. He
sample_responses: Organised it well.
Planned the event systematically, delegated tasks and made it memorable for everyone.
Created a team, planned the budget, arranged entertainment and ensured everyone enjoyed.

scenario: He was ironing his clothes when suddenly he received an electric shock and he noticed the wire burning. He
sample_responses: He will turn the switch off, remove the plug and get the iron repaired.
Immediately switched off the main power, disconnected the iron and got it checked by an electrician.
Turned off the power, ensured safety and got the faulty equipment replaced.

scenario: He was in charge of the wireless board in a sailing ship which lost its communication with the coast. He
sample_responses: Restored communication quickly.
Checked the equipment, identified the fault and fixed it using backup systems.
Tried different frequencies, used emergency communication methods and established contact.

scenario: In a discussion with your colleagues, you find your losing ground, you will
sample_responses: Agree to their better logic.
Listen to their arguments, accept valid points and modify my view if their logic is sound.
Acknowledge their valid points, present my perspective clearly and reach a consensus.

scenario: He was to appear for an exam and all of a sudden the curfew was imposed in that area, he
sample_responses: Showed admit card to the police and took the exam.
Contacted the exam authorities, explained the situation, showed his admit card and sought police escort.
Informed the police about his exam, showed documents and requested them to help him reach the center.

scenario: He went for the picnic with his friends and on the way he had hot arguments with them. He
sample_responses: Will calm down the situation and enjoy the picnic.
Apologised if he was wrong, resolved the misunderstanding and enjoyed the rest of the trip.
Took a break, cooled down, discussed the issue maturely and continued with the picnic.

scenario: There is a person who sells smuggled goods. You too, like many others, have purchased a wristwatch from him. But it doesn't work. You'll
sample_responses: Ask for the replacement.
Confront the seller about the defective product and demand a replacement or refund.
Report the matter to the authorities and warn others about such illegal activities.

scenario: Just two days before the semi-finals of the bridge tournament, his partner was called by his parents and had to go out of station for an urgent work. He
sample_responses: Took another partner and won.
Found a suitable replacement, practiced with him and participated in the tournament.
Informed the organizers about the situation, arranged for a substitute and played to the best of their ability.

scenario: He was rather young when his father was killed in the war and later mother kidnapped by the rival group. He had no other relative. He
sample_responses: Approached the Police to get his mother back and register case against the criminals.
Contacted the police and social services, sought help from authorities and fought the case legally.
Took support from government schemes for war widows, studied hard and built a better future.

scenario: You are on the way to your home suddenly your bicycle got punctured. You'll
sample_responses: Get down, walk with the cycle, get it repaired and ride back home.
Find the nearest puncture shop, get it fixed and continue the journey.
Call a friend for help or take public transport and get the cycle repaired later.

scenario: He urgently needed money. He
sample_responses: Took it from parents.
Arranged from family or close friends and returned it as soon as possible.
Explored legitimate sources like bank loan or advance from employer if it was for genuine need.

scenario: During the exams his teacher threatened him to fail in examination. He
sample_responses: Prepared and performed well and ignored the empty threat.
Worked harder, sought help from other teachers and proved his capability through performance.
Discussed the matter with parents and principal, focused on studies and performed well.

scenario: You are getting late in reaching meeting. You would
sample_responses: Inform the organiser and reach at the earliest.
Call the concerned person, explain the situation, apologize and give expected time of arrival.
Send a message about the delay, find the fastest route and reach as soon as possible.

scenario: He receives conflicting orders from his two superior officers. He
sample_responses: Went to his immediate reporting officer and told him the conflicting order received from the other senior and after clarification obeyed the order.
Politely explained the situation to both seniors, sought clarification and followed the correct chain of command.
Requested a meeting with both officers to resolve the conflict and then proceeded as per final decision.

scenario: He was going to attend SSB interview. On reaching the Railway Station he noticed that his suitcase has been stolen with his original certificates needed at SSB. He
sample_responses: Immediately lodged an FIR, went back and got the original certificates from the college and then attended SSB.
Filed police complaint, contacted his college for duplicate certificates, informed SSB about the situation and attended with available documents.
Reported the theft, arranged for attested copies from home, explained to SSB authorities and appeared for the interview.

scenario: While he was traveling on his scooter, someone at gunpoint demanded his purse. He
sample_responses: Rammed the scooter into him, took his gun and lodged FIR against the criminal.
Stayed calm, tried to alert nearby people, noted the criminal's features and informed the police immediately.
Used his presence of mind, created a distraction, sought help from bystanders and called the police.

scenario: He was going on a bicycle in thick jungle. It was already dark and his destination was 10 Km away. His cycle got punctured. He
sample_responses: Walked with the cycle to destination.
Assessed the puncture, if repairable fixed it, otherwise continued on foot while pushing the cycle.
Used his mobile phone to call for help, if no network then continued walking while staying alert.

scenario: He is new in the city. Suddenly he noticed that all his items were stolen. He had no money in his pocket. He
sample_responses: Got money from home through PAYTM, lodged FIR and managed.
Went to the nearest police station, filed a report, contacted his family for financial help and arranged for basic necessities.
Sought help from local authorities, contacted his family and found temporary accommodation while sorting out the situation.
